## expo-modules-core@58.0.26

### Patch Changes

- [iOS] Reduce the overhead of creating shared objects in JavaScript and
of returning them from native functions.
([#52096](https://github.com/expo/expo/pull/52096) by
[@tsapeta](https://github.com/tsapeta))
- Updated dependencies.
([#52095](https://github.com/expo/expo/pull/52095))
  - expo-modules-jsi@58.0.19
## expo-modules-jsi@58.0.19

### Patch Changes

- [iOS] Add `JavaScriptObject.tryUnsetNativeState()`, which returns
`false` when the native state can't be removed, for example from a
frozen object. `unsetNativeState()` now ignores that case instead of
raising a C++ exception that Swift can't catch.
([#52095](https://github.com/expo/expo/pull/52095) by
[@tsapeta](https://github.com/tsapeta))
